up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against the human leucine-rich repeat serine/threonine-protein kinase (CHEMBL1075104). Return the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, and target information. Do not apply row limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_name, a.standard_value AS ic50_nM FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1075104' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '='
